Fixed-hub two-step returns imply each skip-two component uniform, leaving exactly two extra primitive cycles at even n, and the two monochromatic fixed configurations. Composition counting of cyclic one-runs of length at least two gives exactly R_m coefficients m/k*binom(j-k-1,k-1)*binom(m-j-1,k-1), and the product R_{n/2}^2 for even n. Thus the coefficient filter gives the all-n count; no higher period via symmetric-threshold energy. Direct independently coded wheel majority brute force for rim n=3..8 agrees with fixed=2 and cycles 3,2,5,11,21,34; scripts inspected define additional finite tests through n=17. These are corroboration only.
